name: pet-paint
description: 桌宠颜料大作战：2–4 只桌宠局域网 / 互联网中转颜料抢地盘的单文件 HTML，支持 2D / 3D 桌宠形象与单人对电脑

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:rules && npm run test:net && npm run test:artifact && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:motion-suite: npm run test:net && npm run test:motion
scripts.test:internet: npm run test:artifact && npm run test:relay && npm run test:mixed
scripts.test:delivery: npm test && npm run test:host && npm run test:internet
scripts.test:internet:full: npm run test:internet && npm run test:physical
